summary: Rackspace Technology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) solely to include the base prospectus omitted from an earlier filing. No new securities are being offered. The filing confirms an existing equity distribution agreement with Goldman Sachs for an at-the-market offering of up to $250 million in common stock, with a 1.5% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or corporate actions such as mergers, tenders, or restructuring.
